note: Rio Grande NF (Divide RD) campground on Embargo Creek northwest of Del Norte, ~9,400 ft. Reached by county roads 18, 15 and 65, then 7.6 mi on FR 640, which the Forest Service describes as dirt, single lane with no turnouts. Two loops: the left one around a meadow with a few open sites, the right in dense aspen and spruce; view of Cathedral Rock to the north. Fremont's 1848 winter camp is nearby. --Claude
